title: Discrepancy Detection at the Data Level: Toward Consistent Multilingual Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-based pipeline (MIND) to generate question-answer pairs from an anchor language corpus, retrieving corresponding evidence from a comparison language corpus, and prompting an LLM to classify divergent responses as 'cultural discrepancies' (variations rooted in different cultural norms, practices, or regional policies) versus strict factual contradictions.

Aligning cross-lingual documents (e.g., English-Spanish, English-German) via polylingual topic modeling to detect cross-lingual inconsistencies and evaluate whether a question answering system provides factually and contextually consistent advice across different language-specific knowledge bases.
